simple.meaning: a poisonous plant , probably the poppy (from its conspicuous head); generally poison (even of serpents)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to רֹאשׁ (H7219) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 12 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: רֹאשׁ (rôʼsh) means a poisonous plant , probably the poppy (from its conspicuous head); generally poison (even of serpents) First listed occurrence: Amos 6 12.

definitions.short: a poisonous plant , probably the poppy (from its conspicuous head); generally poison (even of serpents)
definitions.full: H7219. rosh II. ראשׁ and ( Deut 32:32 ) רוֺשׁ noun masculine 32:33 a bitter and poisonous herb, them venom, always figurative; — 1 a bitter and poisonous herb , + (or ||) לַעֲנָה Deut 29:17 ; Lam 3:19 , so ( ראֹשׁ מֵי ) Jer 9:14 ; 23:15 ; ר ׳מֵי (without ׳ל ) 8:14 ; עִנְּכֵירֿוֺשׁ Deuteronomy 22:32 (|| מְרֹרֹת ); וּתְלָאָה ראֹשׁ Lam 3:5 ; ׳ר alone Psa 69:22 , כָּראֹשׁ מִשְׁמָּטוּמָּרַח Hosea 10:4 , לר ׳הְפַכְתֶּם מִשְׁמָּט Amos 6:12 . 2 venom , of serpents, ׳ר מְּתָנִים Deut 32:33 ; Job 20:16 . רוֺשׁ poison , Deut 32:32 , see II. ראֹשׁ .
